$comment: Matches the rule found when it landed (hearsay-tools/cezarion#1804), keyed by file and the first line of the match so a moved line does not churn it. This list only shrinks: fix a match, then run AST_GREP_RULES_UPDATE=1 npm run lint. Rules: .ai/ast-grep/README.md. These are the writers outside run.ts: runs/store.ts reconciles a loaded row (a Stop accepted before an exit, a schema-7 hold, a store opened without keepLive), settles an orphaned queued run and clears a hold on archive; server/server.ts accepts a review on Draft PR. workflows/run-states.ts declares each one as a trigger row whose via names it (store:, server:); routing them is out of this rule's first scope.
